benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Magnet drag and release response
Preconditions: Page loaded, Canvas main stage visible, magnet positioned in the central area of the conductive plate.
Steps:
  1. Click/touch and hold the magnet, drag it across the plate to the edge, then release. -> expected: Magnet follows pointer movement, decelerates and stops after release due to damping, without exceeding plate boundaries.
Pass: Magnet smoothly follows pointer, decelerates naturally after release, and remains within plate bounds.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Magnet smoothly follows pointer, decelerates naturally after release, and remains within plate bounds.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Core parameter sliders take effect in real-time
Preconditions: Page loaded, left control panel visible.
Steps:
  1. Drag the Br, σ, thickness, and gap sliders, observe the numeric outputs on the right and visual changes on the plate. -> expected: Slider values sync with output tags, parameter changes cause variations in eddy-current intensity or drag readings.
Pass: All sliders update values instantly when dragged, and changing parameters causes observable simulation behavior changes (e.g., drag magnitude, streamline density).
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: All sliders update values instantly when dragged, and changing parameters causes observable simulation behavior changes (e.g., drag magnitude, streamline density).

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Eddy-current streamline animation and color mapping
Preconditions: Magnet is moving or just released, #chk-particles is checked.
Steps:
  1. Observe the flowing particles/streamlines on the conductive plate surface, compare their colors and motion speeds. -> expected: Streamlines appear dynamic and swirling/flowing, colors gradient from blue (low density) to red (high density), direction matches physical induction rules.
Pass: Streamlines continuously animate, color gradient accurately reflects current density magnitude, and direction changes reasonably with magnet motion.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Streamlines continuously animate, color gradient accurately reflects current density magnitude, and direction changes reasonably with magnet motion.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Quantitative drag and velocity readout display
Preconditions: Simulation running, control panel visible.
Steps:
  1. Drag the magnet at different speeds, check the drag and velocity readouts on the panel. -> expected: Readouts refresh continuously, display units as N and m/s respectively, values change with drag speed.
Pass: Interface continuously displays drag (N) and velocity (m/s) readouts with correct units, and values change in real-time with operations.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Interface continuously displays drag (N) and velocity (m/s) readouts with correct units, and values change in real-time with operations.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Responsive layout and fullscreen toggle
Preconditions: Page in desktop browser in windowed mode.
Steps:
  1. Drag browser window edges to resize, click #btn-full or press F to toggle fullscreen. -> expected: Canvas scales adaptively maintaining aspect ratio, fullscreen mode enters/exits correctly, UI does not overlap.
Pass: Canvas and panel layout adapt during window resize, fullscreen button/shortcut can normally toggle browser fullscreen state.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Canvas and panel layout adapt during window resize, fullscreen button/shortcut can normally toggle browser fullscreen state.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Material presets and extended parameter binding
Preconditions: Page loaded, #sel-material dropdown visible.
Steps:
  1. Switch Plate material dropdown options, drag μr and mass sliders. -> expected: Material switch updates conductivity slider and plate color; μr and mass slider values sync to physics engine.
Pass: Dropdown switch correctly applies preset conductivity and plate tint, μr/mass slider drag changes physics simulation parameters accordingly.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Dropdown switch correctly applies preset conductivity and plate tint, μr/mass slider drag changes physics simulation parameters accordingly.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Display layer toggles and history plot
Preconditions: Simulation running, Display area checkboxes and #graph canvas visible.
Steps:
  1. Check/uncheck Current streamlines, Current arrows, Flux footprint, Live graph. Observe canvas changes. -> expected: Corresponding visual elements show/hide; Live graph canvas draws scrolling time-series curves for speed and drag.
Pass: Checkboxes correctly control rendering flags, Graph canvas renders real-time dual-axis time-series curves with legend.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Checkboxes correctly control rendering flags, Graph canvas renders real-time dual-axis time-series curves with legend.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Fling/Pause/Reset controls and keyboard shortcuts
Preconditions: Simulation running, Controls area buttons visible.
Steps:
  1. Click Fling, Pause, Reset buttons, press Space, R, F keys respectively. -> expected: Fling assigns random initial velocity; Pause freezes physics step and rendering; Reset restores initial state and clears chart. Shortcuts trigger identical behavior.
Pass: Buttons and shortcuts correctly trigger corresponding functions, state transitions leave no residue or confusion.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Buttons and shortcuts correctly trigger corresponding functions, state transitions leave no residue or confusion.
